summary: The Codex-authored Continuity Aurora design is compatible with LAND-001 requirements: it treats Invofy as mood inspiration only, uses official OncoReady assets, preserves the current product journey, bounds the signature motion effect, and defines responsive and reduced-motion behavior.
review_scope: Compatibility review of the human-approved Codex frontend design against requirements, architecture, brand constraints, accessibility, performance, scope, and truthful product presentation.
notes_for_gemini: The human assigned Codex as the frontend owner for LAND-001, so Codex will implement the approved report.
Preserve current workflow state and callbacks; keep the continuity canvas decorative and independently disposable.
Use the official repository logo assets without redrawing or distorting them.
Do not add reference-template testimonials, customer logos, or unsupported product claims.
Run the existing critical journey after the landing refresh and verify the static reduced-motion presentation.
